notes: Vortex Launcher 0.2.4 - artwork startup crash hotfix. Replaces the scaled image-decoding path that could crash the process when loading mixed-format covers. Adds bounded single-codec decoding, safe thumbnail dimensions and mixed PNG/JPEG/WebP regression tests. If 0.2.2 cannot open, download the platform ZIP and replace only the executable/app in its existing folder. Keep all data folders. Installation-local libraries from 0.2.2 remain unchanged; old global libraries are not automatically imported. Includes unchanged Vortex Client 0.2.1. macOS beta is ad-hoc signed, not notarized; Open Anyway may be required.
